title: TSMC July 2026 Revenue Report
gist: TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) posted July 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$467.58 billion, up 44.7% year over year and 5.6% sequentially from June's NT$442.68 billion, lifting January-July revenue to NT$2,872.06 billion (+37.0% YoY). The YoY growth rate is accelerating sharply versus the 25.8% July 2025 print, which the report attributes to leading-edge orders tied to AI accelerator and data center investment.

insights.claim: TSMC reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$467.58 billion for July 2026, a 44.7 percent increase from July 2025 and a record-setting month.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Sets the revenue baseline for Q3 2026 modeling; a 44.7% YoY monthly run-rate is the number to compare August and September prints against.

insights.so_what: Sequential growth off a high June base implies Q3 revenue guidance risk is skewed to the upside rather than a post-June air pocket.

insights.so_what: The 37.0% year-to-date figure is the cleaner trend signal than any single month and anchors full-year 2026 revenue estimates.

themes.theme: What the monthly print does not show

insights.claim: Monthly revenue disclosure alone reveals nothing about profitability, product mix, manufacturing costs, or currency effects, so the Q3 2026 earnings report is where margins, capacity utilization, capital expenditure, and demand sustainability get tested.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: A reminder that NT-dollar revenue beats can coexist with margin compression from FX or mix; position sizing on the monthly data should wait for the Q3 print.
